name: Eligibility Checklist for AdSense
author: mimusjobs

sections.description:
**Eligibility Checklist for AdSense is a complete AdSense readiness and policy scanner designed to help site owners get approved faster and avoid policy violations.

This plugin performs a deep audit of your site using:
– External keyword lists (GitHub profanity, adult, and harmful content lists)
– Content length + duplication checks
– Thin content detection
– Page structure audits (H1/H2, essential pages, navigation)
– Mobile friendliness checks
– SEO visibility + indexability checks
– Policy risk scoring and warnings

You also get Fix buttons, remediation guides, and optional premium services (full PDF report, article packages, content optimization).

🔥 Key Features

  • Full AdSense readiness score (0–100)
  • Essential pages detection (Home, About, Contact, Privacy Policy)
  • Duplicate content + partial plagiarism heuristics
  • AI/spun content risk scoring
  • Page-level word count audits
  • Image audit (alt text presence)
  • H1/H2 structure scan
  • Mobile-friendly test link
  • Sitemap, robots, canonical, and indexability checks
  • Re-run audit using AJAX (instant)
  • Monetized service cards:
    • $10 full PDF audit report
    • $50 article bundle + site optimization
    • $1/article human-written custom content

Why This Plugin Exists

AdSense approvals in 2025 require stronger content quality, page trust indicators, and consistent site structure. Many site owners fail due to missing pages or thin content.
This plugin solves that by providing a one-page dashboard showing everything Google expects from a compliant site.
